title: Correctness seat template (CKLST-1 A). Source rule: the items are the PR's pinned acceptance lines, read from its backlog card's "## Acceptance" section at the PR's merge-base (pinned before the build, so the PR cannot rewrite them), one item per "- [A<n>]" line, id = the card's own A-id, text verbatim; no card: the DoR prep's "## Acceptance" numbered list at the merge-base, ids A1..An in order; no pinned lines: no rubric, so the seat derives unknown/missing. appliesTo = the PR head. Built by the seat tool, never by the seat.
